_comment: Single source of truth for the content fixes. Read by _tools/content-fixes.js and _tools/lsd_common.py. Dash characters are written as JSON unicode escapes on purpose.

titleRule.why: The founder is Tamara Ćosić (osnivačica) and is not a doctor: the title "Dr"/"dr" is removed when it stands directly before her name. Tamara Vujačić is a DIFFERENT person and IS a doctor: her title "dr" stays wherever she is named.

owner.signature: Tamara Ćosić, osnivačica Lepe Svaki Dan

exactStrings.Tamara Vujačić, Lepa Svaki Dan: Tamara Ćosić, osnivačica Lepe Svaki Dan

owner.exactWhy: Signature line under the founder quote: use founder.signature (client feedback 3, about 3: the founder is Tamara Ćosić, osnivačica Lepe Svaki Dan; Tamara Vujačić is a doctor and a different person).

founder.why: Client feedback 3 (about 3): everywhere the founder is named she is Tamara Ćosić, osnivačica Lepe Svaki Dan. These fields are forced after extraction so a regeneration from the old site (which still says Tamara Vujačić) keeps them. Tamara Vujačić stays only inside the two price-list lines where she is the doctor ("dr")).

dash.exactWhy: A string that is only an em dash is the "not offered here" placeholder in the laser price columns: plain hyphen.
dash.numericRangeEnDash: allowed only when the previous non-space character is a digit or the euro sign and the next non-space character is a digit
